temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is a dedicated friend and hardworking doctor, but Ethan may not yet fully understand how severe Gary's overwork has become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital obligations are intense and that he is not currently willing or able to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is genuinely overwhelmed and at risk from overwork, but he may resist help or rest.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue encouraging Gary to prioritize his health and find another way to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. Ethan confronts Gary, saying he can tell him anything without judgment.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworked and stressed by hospital duties, and a retreat might help him relax and open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest the problem is deeper than ordinary professional overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There are likely personal or emotional reasons behind Gary's overworking, and Gary may be hiding something difficult.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gently confront Gary and offer nonjudgmental support so he feels safe to share his problems.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan listens and offers to help him find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary's overwork may have deeper personal causes beyond ordinary work stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now has a clearer understanding of Gary's specific work pressures and personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is facing significant work and personal stress, but with support he can begin finding a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and remaining challenges, including having had time for a movie recently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is trying to improve and can benefit from ongoing support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reports and behavior confirm that he is making real progress toward a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving and has a growing capacity to manage his work and personal life more healthily.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in, offering encouragement, and being available whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving but may still need some ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary is now managing independently and maintaining a healthier balance on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of sustaining his progress without Ethan's active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back from active support while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
